Capital Brewery Bike Club Tuesday and Thursday Rides

Middleton, WI · Road

Beginner friendly

Capital Brewery Bike Club Tuesday and Thursday Rides is a road group ride in Middleton, WI. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:30 pm from Capital Brewery Beer Garden. About 18–35 miles, a: 20–25 mph, 20–35 mi. B: 16–20 mph, 20–30 mi. C: 12–16 mph, 18–28 mi (e-bikes welcome).

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 20–25 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Capital Brewery Bike Club Tuesday and Thursday Rides group ride

Three road groups roll out of the beer garden and finish back at it. The C group is for beginners and allows pedal-assist e-bikes. Wednesday is a separate e-bike ride and a CORP mountain bike group meets Tuesdays at 5:40. Cancelled if the beer garden closes or it rains after 5 pm.
